title: Page 336
transc:
J. H. Emerick Richmond,  Washn Apl 29th 1865
Florence for Jacob unity pension peltons torch oyster
an abacus will march to Banjo passing trance
Galway leaving Gotham probably on the first of
May Zebra <deletion>order</deletion> <insertion>You</insertion> may order the oyster torch
Attca and all the panama except such as
you think tarquin to retain in Alba over
land to the same place starting persia thicken begot
off Zodiac Let them leave all offal &
stores fanny kind except provisions & shaker behind
or toby sent by water York Jersey .


No 4  8 PM
Plum Nashville  Wash DC Apl 29. 65.
Nancy Dawson Conquer fawn Prescott
Bangor to handle to trammel
Concubine in loath of whinny
fountain Elk He will report
to you by letter bless


No 1  9.30 PM.
Clowry St Louis Mo  Wash. May 1. 1865.
Rosalie plug for Pipe You
may suspend prepare wales for
paxton paining Wilson torch Argyle
for the present unity If hang
attempts to hold out a
saint will be sent to over
run the whole country Wilson
